```{r setup}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(knitr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(flextable)
  library(officer)
})

payload    <- readRDS(params$payload_rds)

# Paket-Funktionen ohne Installation laden: die R-Quelldateien werden vom
# Aufrufer (export_docx) als payload$source_files mitgegeben.
if (length(payload$source_files) > 0) {
  for (f in payload$source_files) {
    if (file.exists(f))
      sys.source(f, envir = globalenv(), keep.source = FALSE)
  }
}

p          <- payload$params
vt1_time   <- payload$vt1_time   %||% NA_real_
vt2_time   <- payload$vt2_time   %||% NA_real_
vt_table   <- payload$vt_table
steps_tab  <- payload$steps_table
mfo_res    <- payload$mfo_result
testleiter <- payload$testleiter %||% ""
geraet     <- payload$geraet     %||% ""
kommentar  <- payload$kommentar  %||% ""
vt_c       <- payload$vt_comments %||% list()
adv_set    <- payload$advanced_settings %||% list()

# ── Einheitliche Glättung für das GESAMTE Dokument ─────────────
# Eine einzige Quelle (adv_set$smooth_n aus der App) steuert die
# Glättungs-Fenster aller Plots (9-Felder + VT-Plots). Kein
# hartkodierter Wert mehr in einzelnen Chunks.
sm <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(adv_set$smooth_n %||% 20))
if (length(sm) != 1 || !is.finite(sm) || sm < 1) sm <- 20

# ── Schrift: Helvetica (Word substituiert wo nötig Arial) ──────
.report_font <- "Helvetica"

dash <- function(x, unit = "") {
  if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) return("-")
  paste0(x, if (nzchar(unit)) paste0(" ", unit) else "")
}
fmtn <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  if (is.null(x) || (length(x) == 1 && is.na(x))) return("-")
  format(round(x, digits), decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".", nsmall = digits)
}

# ── APA-Style flextable-Helfer (Helvetica) ────────────────────
# Schlichter APA-Look: nur horizontale Linien (Top-/Header-/Bottom-
# Rule), keine Vertikalen, fetter Header, deutsche Dezimalkomma.
apa_flex <- function(df, align_body = "left", fontsize = 10,
                     last_left = NULL) {
  ft <- flextable::flextable(df)
  ft <- flextable::font(ft, part = "all", fontname = .report_font)
  ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, part = "all", size = fontsize)
  ft <- flextable::bold(ft, part = "header")
  # Zahlen mit deutschem Format
  ft <- flextable::colformat_double(
    ft, digits = 2, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",", na_str = "-")
  ft <- flextable::colformat_int(ft, big.mark = ".", na_str = "-")
  # APA-Linien
  ft <- flextable::border_remove(ft)
  big <- officer::fp_border(color = "#000000", width = 1.4)
  sm_b <- officer::fp_border(color = "#000000", width = 0.6)
  ft <- flextable::hline_top(ft, border = big, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, border = sm_b, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, border = big, part = "body")
  # Ausrichtung: erste Spalte links, restliche rechts (sofern angefragt)
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, align = align_body, part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::padding(ft, padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3,
                           part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
  ft
}

# ── Gegliederte, mehrspaltige Übersichts-Tabelle ──────────────
# sections: benannte Liste; jedes Element ist ein benannter
# character-Vektor (Werte; Namen = Parameter-Beschriftung).
# Layout: 4 Spalten (Parameter | Wert | Parameter | Wert) mit
# je einer über alle Spalten gemergten Sektions-Überschrift.
overview_flex <- function(sections, fontsize = 10) {
  out <- data.frame(c1 = character(), c2 = character(),
                    c3 = character(), c4 = character(),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  header_idx <- integer(0)
  for (sec_name in names(sections)) {
    sec    <- sections[[sec_name]]
    params <- names(sec); vals <- unname(sec)
    n <- length(params)
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(c1 = sec_name, c2 = "", c3 = "", c4 = "",
                                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    header_idx <- c(header_idx, nrow(out))
    for (i in seq_len(ceiling(n / 2))) {
      l <- 2 * i - 1; r <- 2 * i
      out <- rbind(out, data.frame(
        c1 = params[l], c2 = vals[l],
        c3 = if (r <= n) params[r] else "",
        c4 = if (r <= n) vals[r] else "",
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    }
  }
  ft <- flextable::flextable(out)
  ft <- flextable::delete_part(ft, part = "header")
  ft <- flextable::font(ft, part = "all", fontname = .report_font)
  ft <- flextable::fontsize(ft, part = "all", size = fontsize)
  ft <- flextable::border_remove(ft)
  for (ri in header_idx)
    ft <- flextable::merge_at(ft, i = ri, j = 1:4, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::bold(ft, i = header_idx, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::bg(ft, i = header_idx, bg = "#EAEFF5", part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, j = c(1, 3), align = "left",  part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, j = c(2, 4), align = "right", part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::align(ft, i = header_idx, j = 1, align = "left",
                         part = "body")
  big  <- officer::fp_border(color = "#000000", width = 1.4)
  ft <- flextable::hline_top(ft, border = big, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::hline_bottom(ft, border = big, part = "body")
  ft <- flextable::padding(ft, padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3,
                           part = "all")
  ft <- flextable::autofit(ft)
  ft
}

date_str <- if (!is.null(p$Date) && !is.na(p$Date))
  format(p$Date, "%d.%m.%Y") else format(Sys.Date(), "%d.%m.%Y")
```

## Probandeninformation

```{r proband-tbl}
apa_flex(data.frame(
  Feld = c("Name", "Alter", "Gewicht", "Größe", "Datum",
           "Testleiter:in", "Gerät"),
  Wert = c(p$ID %||% "-",
           dash(p$Age_years, "Jahre"),
           dash(p$Weight_kg, "kg"),
           dash(p$Height_cm, "cm"),
           date_str,
           if (nzchar(testleiter)) testleiter else "-",
           if (nzchar(geraet)) geraet else "-"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
), align_body = "left")
```

## Übersicht

```{r overview-tbl}
bmi <- calc_bmi(p$Weight_kg, p$Height_cm)

overview_sections <- list(
  "Leistung" = c(
    "PPO (W)"       = fmtn(p$PPO, 0),
    "PPO (W/kg)"    = fmtn(p$PPO_wkg, 2),
    "Dauer"         = p$Duration %||% "-"),
  "Kardiopulmonal & metabolisch" = c(
    "VO₂peak abs (L/min)"      = fmtn(p$VO2peak_abs, 2),
    "VO₂peak rel (ml/min/kg)"  = fmtn(p$VO2peak_rel, 1),
    "RERmax"                   = fmtn(p$RERmax, 2),
    "EQO₂max"                  = fmtn(p$EQO2max, 0),
    "HRmax (bpm)"              = fmtn(p$HRmax, 0)),
  "Anthropometrie & Umgebung" = c(
    "BMI (kg/m²)"        = if (!is.na(bmi)) fmtn(bmi, 1) else "-",
    "Temperatur (°C)"    = fmtn(p$Temperature, 1),
    "Luftdruck (mmHg)"   = fmtn(p$AirPressure, 0),
    "Luftfeuchte (%)"    = fmtn(p$Humidity, 0))
)
overview_flex(overview_sections)
```

## Stufenzusammenfassung

```{r steps-tbl, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(steps_tab) && nrow(steps_tab) > 0) {
  # Auf wichtige Spalten beschränken, sonst sprengt die Tabelle die Seite
  cols_want <- intersect(
    c("label", "duration_sec", "P", "VO2", "VO2_kg", "VCO2", "VE", "HR", "RER"),
    names(steps_tab))
  if (length(cols_want) == 0) cols_want <- names(steps_tab)
  tab <- steps_tab[, cols_want, drop = FALSE]
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(apa_flex(tab, fontsize = 8))
} else {
  cat("_Keine Stufendaten verfügbar._\n")
}
```

## 9-Felder-Darstellung

```{r nine-panel, fig.width=8, fig.height=7.5, dpi=200}
np <- tryCatch(
  nine_panel_assemble(
    ts = p$ts, smooth_n = sm, label = p$ID %||% "",
    vt = p$vt, vt1_time = vt1_time, vt2_time = vt2_time,
    panels = as.character(1:9), ncol = 3),
  error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(np)) {
  if (inherits(np, "gtable") || inherits(np, "grob"))
    grid::grid.draw(np) else print(np)
}
```

```{r mfo-section, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(mfo_res)) {
  cat("## Maximale Fettoxidation (MFO)\n\n")
  mfo_df <- data.frame(
    Parameter = c("MFO (g/min)", "Fatmax (%VO2peak)",
                  "Fatmax (W)", "Fatmax (HR bpm)"),
    Wert = c(
      fmtn(mfo_res$MFO, 3),
      fmtn(mfo_res$Fatmax_pct_VO2peak, 1),
      fmtn(mfo_res$Fatmax_W, 0),
      fmtn(mfo_res$Fatmax_HR, 0)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  flextable::flextable_to_rmd(apa_flex(mfo_df))
}
```

## Erweiterte Einstellungen

```{r adv-settings-tbl}
adv_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Mittelungs-Fenster (Sek.)",
                "Min. Stufendauer (Sek.)",
                "Körpergewicht-Override (kg)",
                "Glättungs-Fenster (Punkte, gesamtes Dokument)"),
  Wert = c(
    if (!is.null(adv_set$window_sec) && !is.na(adv_set$window_sec))
      as.character(adv_set$window_sec) else "30 (Default)",
    if (!is.null(adv_set$min_step) && !is.na(adv_set$min_step))
      as.character(adv_set$min_step)  else "15 (Default)",
    if (!is.null(adv_set$weight) && !is.na(adv_set$weight))
      as.character(adv_set$weight)    else "aus Datei",
    as.character(sm)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
apa_flex(adv_df)
```
